headline: Congress named a San Francisco post office after former Senator Dianne Feinstein.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 180 Steuart Street in San Francisco, California, as the Dianne Feinstein Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or the rules that apply to mail.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 23, 2024.
